scope: Bridgetown-Greenbushes existing vacancy event, adopted extraordinary election date and method only

primarySources.title: Bridgetown-Greenbushes Special Council Meeting minutes, 5 November 2026
primarySources.supports: Adopted resolution SCM 182-26/27 on page5; meeting report and limited follow-up context on pages6,7,9; closure on page10.

httpObservation.method: Ordinary urllib fresh GET, no raw file retained

adoptedDecision.dateWording: Resolution notes Commissioner has set the election date

finding: The 5 November 2026 minutes record adopted resolution SCM 182-26/27, carried 6/0 by absolute majority: the Electoral Commissioner will conduct the extraordinary election by post, and the resolution notes the Commissioner-set date of Thursday 18 March 2027. The calendar-day countdown marks that date in Perth. A postal receipt hour, roll and nomination timetable, and candidates await separate official notices. The resignation-date discrepancy between the 9 October notice and later meeting papers remains attributed in the prior source review. Other retained roster entries were not freshly verified.
limits: The officer-report text on page 9 says officers will advise the Commissioner, seek approval and publish required notices; this generic follow-up text does not replace the adopted page 5 resolution. No separate detailed election notice was verified in this bounded review.
The minutes publish an election day, not a postal receipt cutoff hour. No precise instant, nomination window or candidate stage is inferred.
The earlier resignation-date discrepancy is preserved in history and the 13 November source review. No other member or election record is freshly certified.
